concept: Fictional late-eighteenth-century European palace antechamber admission
selection_method: Independent arbitrary authorial choice within coordinator-assigned European-court scope; no sibling or candidate inputs
reference_scope: Visible face and hair only; no inference of real identity, age, personality, consent or history

predata_observation_questions.strict_rule: All participants, boundary and connecting route must read together; decorative palace resemblance alone is insufficient

predata_observation_questions.expected: A coherent fictional European court setting and late-eighteenth-century dress idiom
predata_observation_questions.strict_rule: Inspect clothing and architecture; no nationality or culture is inferred from facial appearance; historical documentary accuracy is outside this fictional test

predata_observation_questions.expected: The central woman's visible facial contours, short dark bob and separated wispy fringe remain recognizably guided by the supplied image
predata_observation_questions.strict_rule: Compare saved output with original reference; this supports appearance correspondence only, never verified identity

predata_observation_questions.expected: Separate actors, coherent standing support, a hand gripping the door handle and another hand indicating an empty route
predata_observation_questions.strict_rule: Hidden required support/contact is partial or unobservable, never a full pass
